RepeatButton.description: The RepeatButton control is like a standard Button, except that the Click event occurs continuously while the user presses the RepeatButton.

samples.title: A simple RepeatButton with text content.

Viewbox.description: Use a Viewbox control scale content up or down to a specified size.

samples.title: Content inside of a Viewbox.
samples.xaml:
<Viewbox Height="200" Width="200" StretchDirection="Both">
    <Border BorderBrush="Gray" BorderThickness="15">
        <StackPanel Background="DarkGray">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                <Rectangle Fill="Blue" Height="10" Width="40"/>
                <Rectangle Fill="Green" Height="10" Width="40"/>
                <Rectangle Fill="Red" Height="10" Width="40"/>
                <Rectangle Fill="Yellow" Height="10" Width="40"/>
            </StackPanel>
            <Image Source="ms-appx:///Assets/SampleMedia/Slices.png"/>
            <TextBlock Text="This is text." HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </Border>
</Viewbox>
